title: Foreign Minister Arrives in Ashgabat
text:
Foreign Minister Arrives in Ashgabat"

"Abbas Araghchi, Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Islamic Republic of Iran, arrived in Ashgabat, the capital of Turkmenistan, on Monday morning for an official visit."

"During the trip, the Foreign Minister will meet with senior Turkmen officials and hold talks and consultations on strengthening cooperation and expanding bilateral relations in various political and economic fields.
